invariants.rationale: A public method returning a list should not return null (collectors.toList always provides a non-null list).
The final collected list filters out nulls before collecting, so no element is null.
The deduplication merges records with the same key, so the output can only be smaller or equal in size.
The method assumes a non-null records list for streaming and mapping operations.
Parallelism is expected to be a positive integer indicating degree of concurrency; otherwise parallel processing would not work as intended.
